meta.name: pestel-delta-monitor
meta.description: Quarterly re-scan of a prior PESTEL analysis. Use when checking which macro factors moved, which assumptions broke, and what's new — turning PESTEL from a workshop artifact into a radar.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定期扫描宏观环境变化，更新PESTEL分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果定期需要追踪宏观因素变化并更新战略假设。
copy.tagline_en: Rescan macro environment changes and update PESTEL analysis quarterly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to track macro factor shifts and update strategic assumptions regularly.

howto.what: 当用户提供旧版PESTEL分析时,Claude会逐项对比各宏观因素变化,只报告有实质变动之处,标出已被证据推翻的原有假设,最后输出结构化的增量报告。
howto.when: 当用户想核查旧版PESTEL之后的宏观变化,并手头有那份旧分析时触发;若无旧版,它会先建议进行一次PESTEL分析。

say.text: 这是我们上个季度的PESTEL,帮我看看哪些因素变了
say.note: 会逐项对比并输出增量报告

say.text: 基于这份分析,哪些原有假设现在不成立了?
say.note: 它会标出被证据推翻的基线条目

say.text: 有个新的AI责任法规,重新扫一遍宏观环境
say.note: 它会优先核查这一事件的影响

howto.what_en: When a prior PESTEL analysis is provided, Claude diffs each macro factor against that baseline, reports only material movements, flags baseline assumptions now contradicted by evidence, and produces a structured delta report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to re-check a previous PESTEL analysis for macro changes and supplies that baseline. If none is given, it recommends running pestel-analysis first and stops.

say_en.text: Here is our last quarter's PESTEL — check which factors have moved.
say_en.note: It will diff factor by factor and output a delta report.

say_en.text: Based on this analysis, which assumptions no longer hold?
say_en.note: It will identify contradicted baseline entries.

say_en.text: A new AI liability regulation just passed; rescan the macro environment.
say_en.note: It will check that event first.
